about:
# Auction House DataBase (AHDB) - WoW Forever edition

AHDB scans the whole auction house, keeps a price history per item that you can see as a graph (Alt-click any item),
shows vendor and AH prices in item tooltips and warns you before you list something for less than a vendor would pay.
Your characters on other accounts can share their prices, and one parked at the AH can look up current prices for you.
Anyone in your guild or group can ask for a price with `!ahdb <item>` in chat.

The Classic / Mists / retail versions (and their MoLib based code) are on the
[legacy](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/tree/legacy) branch.

## Price history graph

**Alt-click any item** (bags, bank, chat links, AH lists, merchant...) or use `/ahdb price <item>` (or
`/ahdb graph <item>` for just the window; a link, itemID, name or part of a name like `wool cloth`) to see its price
history, even away from the AH:

![Price history window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/master/screenshots/price-history.png)

- Each bar goes from the lowest to the median unit price: per scan for the recent scans (side by side, a line marks the
  hours without scans), per day for the last 30 or 180 days. Hover for the values.
- The quantity listed is under the graph, the vendor price is the green line.
- 7 and 30 day median prices and the lowest price seen, for each auction house (Alliance, Horde, Neutral).
- Random suffix gear ("of the Monkey", "of the Whale"...): the prices of that suffix, or uncheck "This suffix only" for
  all the item's suffixes together. Opened from an AH list (no suffix there), it's always all of them.
- Drag the bottom right corner to make the window bigger, it keeps its size and place.
- Each auction house's last 30 scans are kept (whole days, up to 7 days), then one summary per day for 180 days, so the
  saved data stays small even when scanning every 15 minutes.

## Sharing prices between your accounts

Saved data is per WoW account. To use the prices one account scanned on another one's characters (e.g. one
character parked at the AH, another one out in the world):

- `/ahdb trust <First Last>` (or target the character and `/ahdb trust`) on both sides, then:
- Item tooltips tell when an online trusted character has newer prices ("AH price 3h old, Alt: ask Wa"): hold Alt
  to get them. The price window gets them by itself. They're added to your price history.
- **Live** button of the price window (or `/ahdb live <item>`): a trusted character at an open AH searches the item
  right now (fresher than its last scan) and sends its current min / median price and quantity listed; both
  characters show it in chat and add it to their price history.
- Only between characters of the same faction (whispers don't cross factions): each faction has its own trusted
  characters. `/ahdb trust` lists who's trusted and online.
- Out of the game, [ahdbmerge](https://github.com/mooreatv/AHDBapp#merging-price-history-between-your-wow-accounts-and-computers-wow-forever)
  merges the price history of all the accounts of a WoW install, and keeps it in sync between your computers
  (v0.4.0 or later on all of them: earlier ones drop the prices per suffix of random suffix gear, and don't get
  them). The prices shared
  between characters in game (Alt, price window, Live) are those of all the suffixes of an item together.

## What does it do?

- Opening the auction house starts a full scan (Blizzard allows one every 15 minutes per game session; hold Shift to
  skip it). The "AHDB Scan" button above the AH shows when the next scan is possible. Away from the AH, a chat
  message tells when it's possible again, and the minimap button's tooltip (or `/ahdb next`) shows the time left
  (right-click the button for the options, drag it to move it).
- The game's full scan misses part of the stackable items' auctions (commodities: cloth, ores, herbs...; up to 70% of
  an item). Right after it, AHDB pages through the AH's own search (a few seconds) for their real quantities listed
  and min prices, the same as the AH shows. Their median is that of the auctions the scan had.
- Prices are kept separately for the Alliance, Horde and neutral (goblin) auction houses of each ruleset (Normal, PvP,
  RP, RP-PvP, Hardcore) and region, as they are separate auction houses. The price history saved before that
  (up to v2.6.1, all rulesets together) goes to the ruleset of the first character you log in with after updating: on
  each account, log in first on the ruleset you scanned the most.
- Item tooltips show the vendor price per unit (the game's own line is for the whole stack) and the last scan's
  AH min and median price, how many are listed, and the 30 day min - median. For random suffix gear these are the
  prices of that suffix (its "any suffix" line has all of them: min - median), or of all its suffixes when that one
  wasn't seen yet (prices per suffix from v2.8.0 on, on WoW Forever). Also install
  [BVP](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/better-vendor-price)
  (BetterVendorPrice) for full stack and stack size vendor prices: BVP then shows the vendor lines and AHDB the AH
  ones, no duplicates.
- On the AH sell page, the price turns red with a warning when, after the AH cut, you'd get less than a vendor pays.
- Items vendors refuse even though they have a sell price are learned and get no vendor price (`/ahdb unsellable`).
- Price history graph of any item: Alt-click it or `/ahdb price <item>` (see above).
- Prices shared with your characters on other accounts, and live AH prices from one parked at the AH (see above).
- `!ahdb <item>` (link, itemID or name) in guild, party or raid chat, from anyone: AHDB answers there with the item's
  last AH prices, its 30 day min - median and its vendor price (AHDB users see it with colors and coins; a link of
  random suffix gear gets that suffix's prices when known). With several
  AHDB users around, one answers: the one with the most recent scan.
  Part of a name (`!ahdb cloth`) gets the list of the matching items to pick from. When nobody has a price, the one
  with the most recent scan says so.
- Optionally ("Record full scans" in the options) it also keeps every auction of the last scans, which
  [AHDBapp](https://github.com/mooreatv/AHDBapp) can load into a database for your own analysis of the economy
  (as the game's full scan has them: commodities are incomplete). Big auction houses fill the saved data fast: AHDB
  drops the oldest recorded scans before it gets bigger than what WoW can load.
- `/ahdb bug` shows a copyable log for bug reports. `/ahdb` lists all commands.

## More information

Get the binary release using [curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/auction-house-database)
client or other addon manager or on wowinterface.

The source of the addon resides on https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB

Releases detail/changes are on https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/releases

releases.notes:
# Auction House DataBase (AHDB)

## [v2.8.3](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/tree/v2.8.3) (2026-11-25)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/compare/v2.8.2...v2.8.3) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/releases)

- Saved data no longer gets too big for WoW to load on big auction houses (#84)  
    - AHDB keeps its saved data under what WoW can load ("constant table overflow", which lost all the price history): the oldest recorded full scans are dropped first, and only as a last resort the price history of the suffix variants not seen for the longest time. Fixes #83  
    - Full scan recordings are a third smaller: copies of the same item that differ only by where they dropped (ContentTuning) share one item key.  
    - When the saved data fails to load, AHDB says so at login, so it can be copied before the next save replaces it.

# Auction House DataBase (AHDB)

## [v2.8.2](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/tree/v2.8.2) (2026-11-22)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/compare/v2.8.1...v2.8.2) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/releases)

- Commodity quantities match the AH, live searches find gear (#82)  
    - The game's full scan misses part of the commodities' auctions (cloth, ores, herbs, arrows...: 8 to 70% of an item's quantity, at both faction AHs). Right after the scan AHDB pages through the AH's own search for their real quantities listed and min prices, the numbers the AH shows. It waits while AHVendorFlip buys.  
    - Live searches (/ahdb live, Live button) work for gear: the item is looked up by name first to get the AH's own item keys (item level, suffixes), all its result pages are read.

# Auction House DataBase (AHDB)

## [v2.8.1](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/tree/v2.8.1) (2026-11-18)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/compare/v2.8.0...v2.8.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/releases)

- Full scan recording no longer breaks the saved data, no "any suffix" on crafting previews (#81)  
    - With "Record full scans" on, the item DB only keeps the items of the kept scans: it used to only grow until WoW couldn't load the saved data anymore ("constant table overflow") and the history was lost. Fixes #80  
    - Crafting and quest reward previews of items without a suffix no longer show "any suffix" prices: their placeholder bonus ID (3524) is ignored. #77

# Auction House DataBase (AHDB)

## [v2.8.0](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/tree/v2.8.0) (2026-11-18)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/compare/v2.7.1...v2.8.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/mooreatv/AuctionDB/releases)

- Prices per random suffix ("of the Monkey") on WoW Forever (#79)  
    Tooltips, the price window ("This suffix only") and !ahdb with a link use that suffix's prices; recorded full scans have the item info again. Fixes #77  
- No more errors from chat in battlegrounds, !ahdb only answered in guild, party and raid (#78)  
    * No more errors from chat in battlegrounds (secret chat messages are ignored)  
    Fixes #76  
    * !ahdb isn't answered in instance chat (battlegrounds, strangers) anymore, only guild, party and raid
